newsitem.title: USA: Bon-Ton Sept same sales up 1.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bon-Ton Sept same sales up 1.0 pct.

text.p: The Bon-Ton Stores Inc said Thursday that sales for the five weeks ended October 5, 1996, totaled $57.0 million, an increase of 4.8 percent, versus $54.4 million reported in the same period last year.

Year-to-date sales increased 3.7 percent to a level of $363.6 million from $350.6 million reported in the same period last year. Comparable store sales increased 1.6 percent for the year-to-date period.

The company said sales were in line with expectations, given the fact that Labor Day fell into the August reporting period this year, as opposed to last year, when it was part of the September sales period. Shoes, coats, home, all of the misses sportswear complex and cosmetics showed increases above the company average.
